comment: Held-out fights for testing a policy change the battery was used to design. Selected 2026-09-18 by a fixed rule, before any treatment ran on them: from the sweep1 archive sweep (control policy only, 5 seeds), fights won 1-4 of 5, singles only, against trainers that appear nowhere in scenarios/battery.json, first fight per trainer by report name. Five of them (James, Luna, Dylan, Maria, Bianca) were also measured by the control during battery curation; no treatment and no tape analysis has touched any of them. Names carry fight numbers from run.trainerIndexOf on each fight's own document.
